en.title: Setting Up Tournament Targets
en.excerpt: Master guide to tournament target management: configuring physical target butts (1A-1D), understanding the 2 target dashboard pages, automated World Archery draw algorithms, and scoring safety protections.

toc.text: 1. Two Target Management Pages in Dashboard
3. Board Numbering & World Archery (A, B, C, D) Details
4. Auto-Assign: Standard Draw vs. Field Draw (Club Spread)
6. Scoring Integrity Locks & Smart Reset Protections

en.content:
Target lane management in Archeris controls how physical shooting butts on the field are configured and how registered archers are assigned to specific shooting positions (1A, 1B, 1C, 1D). This system is split into two specialized interfaces: Master Field Target Setup and Qualification Session Target Allocation.

1. Two Target Management Pages in Dashboard

To keep tournament logistics organized, Archeris separates venue capacity from session scheduling:

  • 1. Master Targets Page (Organizer Dashboard > Tournaments > [Tournament] > Targets): Used to register the physical hardware available at your venue (e.g., Target 1 to 30, with 1 to 4 target faces per butt). This sets the tournament's overall shooting capacity.
  • 2. Qualification Session Allocation Page (Organizer Dashboard > Qualification > [Select Session] > Target Management): The interactive workspace where participants in specific categories are placed onto target butts using Auto-Assign algorithms or manual drag-and-drop.

2. Configuring Master Field Targets

Before archers can be assigned to targets, you must register your field's target butts:

  1. Go to Organizer Dashboard > Tournaments > [Your Tournament] > Targets.
  2. Click + Add Target.
  3. Specify the Target Quantity (number of butts to create sequentially) and Target Face Count (1, 2, 3, or 4 boards per butt: A, B, C, D).
  4. Click Create Targets. The system automatically provisions the sequential butts and labels (e.g., Target 1 → 1A, 1B, 1C, 1D).

You can toggle between Grid View (visual target board diagram) and Table View (compact management list). Targets with existing archer assignments cannot be deleted accidentally without first unassigning those participants.

3. Board Numbering & World Archery (A, B, C, D) Details

In standard outdoor and indoor target archery under World Archery rules:

  • Detail 1 (Wave 1): Archers in positions A and C shoot together on the first shooting horn.
  • Detail 2 (Wave 2): Archers in positions B and D shoot together on the second shooting horn.
  • End Alternation: In the following end, Detail 2 (B & D) shoots first, followed by Detail 1 (A & C), ensuring equal wind and lighting conditions for all competitors.

For 3-spot vertical indoor targets or small ranges, butts can be set to 2 boards (A, B) or 3 boards (A, B, C).

4. Auto-Assign: Standard Draw vs. Field Draw (Club Spread)

When placing archers in a qualification session, Archeris offers two automated draw algorithms powered by an IANSEO-compatible constraint solver:

  • A. Standard Draw (Undian Standar - Pure Random): Shuffles all confirmed (paid) participants in the category randomly and fills target slots sequentially following the World Archery A → C → B → D wave pattern to maintain balanced detail distribution across all butts.
  • B. Field Draw (Undian Lapangan - Fair Club Separation): The international tournament standard. The algorithm groups archers by club/delegation and sorts clubs with the largest rosters first. It then runs a multi-pass penalty evaluation to:
    1. Avoid Same-Club on Same Target (10,000 pt penalty): Strictly prevents archers from the same club from sharing a target butt, preserving peer-scoring neutrality.
    2. Avoid Same-Club in Same Wave (8,000 pt penalty): If target capacity forces teammates onto the same butt, it places them in opposite details (Wave 1: A/C vs. Wave 2: B/D) so they never shoot simultaneously on the line.
    3. Balanced Target Loading: Evenly distributes athlete density across active target butts.

5. Interactive Manual Slotting & Drag-and-Drop

For fine-tuning or custom placements:

  • Kanban Unassigned Sidebar: Shows all confirmed participants grouped by club. Simply drag any archer card onto an available target position (A, B, C, D).
  • Position Swapping (Tukar Posisi): Dragging one assigned archer onto another assigned slot automatically swaps their positions without requiring you to clear slots first.
  • Archer Dropdown Picker: Clicking an empty slot opens an instant search picker to select and seat archers in seconds.

6. Scoring Integrity Locks & Smart Reset Protections

To protect competition data integrity during live tournaments, Archeris enforces strict safety rules:

  • Live Scoring Auto-Lock: As soon as the first qualification score is recorded for a category (ends_completed > 0), Auto-Assign, Reset, and bulk target adjustments are automatically locked at the API level.
  • Smart Reset: Clicking Reset Assignments only unseats archers who have not shot yet. Any archer with existing scores is safely preserved in place.
  • Multi-Category Session Protection: When multiple categories share one qualification session, running Auto-Assign on Category B will never overwrite slots already occupied by Category A.
  • Scorekeeper Mobile QR Codes: Each target butt generates a unique Board Code (e.g., 001TGT) with QR code support for instant mobile scorekeeper tablet authentication.

id.title: Pengaturan Bantalan & Target Sasaran
id.excerpt: Panduan lengkap manajemen target turnamen: konfigurasi fisik bantalan (1A-1D), perbedaan 2 halaman dashboard target, algoritma undian otomatis World Archery, dan proteksi integritas nilai.

toc.text: 1. Dua Halaman Pengelolaan Target di Dashboard
3. Sistem Penomoran Papan & Gelombang World Archery (A, B, C, D)
4. Auto-Assign: Undian Standar vs. Undian Lapangan (Sebar Klub)

id.content:
Manajemen target di Archeris mengatur kapasitas fisik bantalan sasaran di lapangan tembak dan penempatan atlet ke posisi tembak masing-masing (1A, 1B, 1C, 1D). Sistem ini terbagi menjadi dua bagian terintegrasi: Master Target Lapangan dan Alokasi Target Sesi Kualifikasi.

1. Dua Halaman Pengelolaan Target di Dashboard

Agar operasional turnamen rapi dan terstruktur, Archeris memisahkan kapasitas fisik venue dari alokasi peserta per sesi lomba:

  • 1. Halaman Master Target (Dashboard Organizer > Turnamen > [Turnamen Anda] > Targets): Digunakan untuk mendaftarkan seluruh bantalan sasaran fisik yang tersedia di lapangan (contoh: Bantalan 1 sampai 24, dengan 1 sampai 4 face target per bantalan). Ini adalah data master kapasitas venue Anda.
  • 2. Halaman Alokasi Sesi Kualifikasi (Dashboard Organizer > Kualifikasi > [Pilih Sesi] > Alokasi Target): Tempat panitia mendistribusikan atlet kategori tertentu ke nomor bantalan menggunakan Undian Otomatis (Auto-Assign) atau penataan manual geser-letakkan (*drag-and-drop*).

2. Konfigurasi Master Target Lapangan

Sebelum menempatkan atlet ke bantalan, Anda perlu membuat daftar bantalan master turnamen:

  1. Buka menu Dashboard Organizer > Turnamen > [Pilih Turnamen] > Targets.
  2. Klik tombol + Add Target.
  3. Masukkan Jumlah Target (banyaknya bantalan yang dibuat berurutan) dan Jumlah Face Target (1, 2, 3, atau 4 papan per bantalan: A, B, C, D).
  4. Klik Buat Target. Sistem otomatis menghasilkan nomor bantalan sekuensial beserta label hurufnya (misal: Target 1 → 1A, 1B, 1C, 1D).

Anda bisa beralih antara Grid View (visualisasi grafis bantalan) dan Table View (tampilan tabel ringkas). Bantalan yang sedang ditempati atlet pada babak kualifikasi diproteksi agar tidak dapat terhapus tanpa sengaja.

3. Sistem Penomoran Papan & Gelombang World Archery (A, B, C, D)

Sesuai regulasi resmi World Archery untuk target outdoor dan indoor:

  • Gelombang 1 (Detail 1): Pemanah pada posisi A dan C maju dan menembak bersamaan pada tiupan peluit pertama.
  • Gelombang 2 (Detail 2): Pemanah pada posisi B dan D maju dan menembak pada giliran kedua.
  • Rotasi Rambahan: Pada rambahan berikutnya, giliran dirotasi (Detail 2 B & D menembak duluan, diikuti Detail 1 A & C) untuk menjamin kesetaraan kondisi angin dan pencahayaan.

Untuk kategori pemula atau target face vertikal 3-spot indoor, bantalan dapat diatur menjadi 2 posisi (A, B) atau 3 posisi (A, B, C).

4. Auto-Assign: Undian Standar vs. Undian Lapangan (Sebar Klub)

Saat menempatkan atlet di babak kualifikasi, Archeris menyediakan dua algoritma pengundian otomatis standar internasional:

  • A. Undian Standar (Standard Draw - Acak Murni): Mengacak seluruh pemanah berstatus lunas (*paid*) secara murni dan mengisi slot bantalan secara berurutan mengikuti pola gelombang World Archery A → C → B → D agar beban giliran tembak terbagi seimbang.
  • B. Undian Lapangan (Field Draw - Sebar Atlet Seklub): Standar kejuaraan resmi. Algoritma mengelompokkan atlet berdasarkan klub/kontingen dan memproses kontingen terbesar terlebih dahulu. Sistem menjalankan kalkulasi penalti bertingkat:
    1. Mencegah Atlet Seklub di Bantalan yang Sama (Penalti 10.000 poin): Mencegah rekan satu klub berada di satu bantalan demi menjaga netralitas pencatatan skor silang (*peer scoring*).
    2. Memisahkan Gelombang Tembak (Penalti 8.000 poin): Jika keterbatasan bantalan memaksa atlet satu klub berada di bantalan yang sama, mereka otomatis dipisahkan ke gelombang berbeda (Wave 1: A/C vs. Wave 2: B/D) sehingga tidak berdiri berdampingan di garis tembak.
    3. Pemerataan Kepadatan Lapangan: Mendistribusikan beban atlet secara merata ke seluruh nomor bantalan yang aktif.

5. Penataan Manual & Drag-and-Drop Antarbantalan

Jika panitia perlu melakukan penyesuaian khusus (misal mengakomodasi atlet kidal di posisi A/C atau atlet disabilitas kursi roda di bantalan dekat akses jalan):

  • Panel Atlet Belum Diatur (Unassigned): Menampilkan atlet yang belum mendapat bantalan, dikelompokkan rapi per klub. Cukup tarik (*drag*) kartu atlet ke posisi A, B, C, atau D.
  • Tukar Posisi Instan (Swap): Menyeret atlet yang sudah berada di bantalan ke slot atlet lain akan otomatis menukar (*swap*) posisi kedua atlet tanpa perlu mengosongkan slot terlebih dahulu.
  • Dropdown Pencarian Cepat: Klik slot kosong untuk membuka popover pencarian cepat nama atlet.

6. Proteksi Integritas Skor & Kunci Otomatis

Untuk melindungi keabsahan data saat turnamen berlangsung, Archeris menerapkan proteksi ketat:

  • Kunci Otomatis Saat Penilaian Berjalan: Begitu rambahan kualifikasi pertama mulai dinilai (ends_completed > 0), fungsi Auto-Assign, Reset, dan pengubahan target otomatis dikunci total di backend API demi mencegah kerusakan data rekapitulasi nilai.
  • Smart Reset: Tombol Atur Ulang (Reset) hanya mengosongkan posisi atlet yang belum memiliki skor. Atlet yang sudah mengantongi nilai kualifikasi akan tetap aman dipertahankan pada bantalannya.
  • Proteksi Multi-Kategori Satu Sesi: Jika beberapa kategori berbagi sesi kualifikasi yang sama, menjalankan Auto-Assign pada Kategori B tidak akan menimpa bantalan yang telah diisi oleh Kategori A.
  • Kode QR Bantalan Scorekeeper: Setiap bantalan memiliki Board Code unik (contoh: 001TGT) yang dapat dipindai langsung oleh aplikasi mobile petugas skor (Scorekeeper).
